purpose: Define Expose as the human/web-facing architecture over existing AIGMos canonical/runtime semantics, without creating a parallel backend or privileged execution path.

does_not_own: runtime execution authority unless explicitly referenced

topics.name: Expose
topics.purpose: Define Expose as the human/web-facing architecture over existing AIGMos canonical/runtime semantics, without creating a parallel backend or privileged execution path.

operations.name: Project canonical semantics to human-facing surface

semantics.backend_rule: Expose is not a parallel backend/runtime.
semantics.read_rule: Reads are projections over canonical/runtime sources.
semantics.write_rule: Writes invoke explicit canonical operations owned elsewhere.
semantics.authority_rule: UI visibility or control presence does not grant authority.
semantics.protocol_rule: REST/OSC/WebSocket/web bindings expose existing operations and data; they do not redefine semantics.
semantics.meta_visibility_rule: Meta is not under Expose unless a MetaModule has an exposed human-facing surface.

invariants.rule: Expose, nanoCMS, MetaModules and Editor remain projections/compositions over canonical semantics and never create hidden runtime authority.

hard_gates.condition: Expose bypasses Core dispatcher or AccessCore
Meta semantics treated as Expose-owned solely because they are visible

references.purpose: UserModule exposure reuses canonical runtime surfaces.

prose.summary: Define Expose as the human/web-facing architecture over existing AIGMos canonical/runtime semantics, without creating a parallel backend or privileged execution path.
